description: Search the Consolidated Screening List (OFAC SDN and other Treasury lists; BIS Entity, Denied Persons, Unverified and Military End User lists; State ITAR-debarred and nonproliferation lists) by name, alias or identifier (IMO, SWIFT/BIC, registration number). Close spellings match. Each result gives the list, programs, addresses, IDs, remarks and the official list link; the answer says when each list last changed.

country.description: Only entries with an address in this country (two-letter code).

min_score.description: How close a name must be. 1 is exact; lower allows more spelling variation.

query.description: A name (person, company, vessel, aircraft) or an identifier.

name: search_screening_lists
title: Search the US screening lists
